name: Ground Lamb
siboNotes: Plain ground lamb is FODMAP-free and well-tolerated on SIBO diets. Avoid pre-seasoned varieties that may contain garlic or onion.
preparationTips: Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like oregano, thyme, or rosemary
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic for flavor
Drain excess fat after cooking to improve digestibility
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin B12 and zinc
Good source of iron and selenium
